summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package advertises itself as a datetime utility under the @servicetitan scope but ships an install-time dropper unrelated to that purpose. package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip`, extracts it, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` against a sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle carrying the `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, a large numeric/string constant table (`n7gIxM=[...]`), an array-rotation routine (`WV8StW`), and a custom string decoder (`hc1jfK9`) — obfuscator-style anti-analysis packaging. Executing the payload under Bun rather than Node keeps it outside the Node require graph and opaque to standard Node-based inspection. A datetime utility has no legitimate need to pull a second runtime and run a 727KB obfuscated bundle at install time. The package's use of the @servicetitan scope alongside these behaviors is consistent with scope impersonation targeting installers who trust that namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
